推荐查询返回成功解析的歌曲，跳过无法加载的歌曲。

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "music.recommend",
  "requestId": "recommend",
  "data": {}
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "music.recommend",
  "requestId": "recommend",
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "album": "",
        "artist": "artist",
        "durationMs": 3600000,
        "id": "recommended",
        "name": "同名歌曲",
        "pictureUrl": "",
        "source": "netease",
        "webUrl": "https://music.163.com/#/song?id=recommended"
      }
    ],
    "totalSize": 1
  }
}
